newsitem.title: UK: Ghana cocoa purchases still lag behind last year.
newsitem.headline: Ghana cocoa purchases still lag behind last year.

text.p: Ghana cocoa purchases in the 10th week of the 1996/97 season (Oct-Sept) ending December 19 amounted to 11,795 tonnes, the Ghana Cocoa Board said on Monday.

Purchases totalled 10,969 tonnes in the 9th week ending December 12. The figures compared with 15,973 in December 21 and 16,254 in December 14 which corresponded to the 11th and the 10th week of the 1995/96 season.

Cumulative purchases by the end of December 19 of 1996/97 were 184,034 tonnes compared with 259,718 by December 21, 1995. By the end of the 10th week of the last season, cumulative purchases were 243,745 tonnes.
